notes.title: Update 03.03.19
notes.content:
[b]A new location has been added to this update. To complete the game, you will need to get to this island. At this location you will need to look for clues to find the exit.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34292813/9187009816f90661cd64910c9c9707d212cce787.png[/img]

[b]Also, bugs were fixed when the character went beyond the islands. Change the fog intensity and increase the lamp brightness. Increase the speed of movement of the character.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34292813/34351d383bbf39e97bd95184885ef30da47c995a.png[/img]

notes.title: Postpone Release Date
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34292813/9d79bf330ce501460a62bea9d0dc12384d0e2d94.png[/img]

[b]The release of the game will be postponed for several days in order to add more different content, thereby increasing interest and passing.[/b]

[list][*]Increase the size of the second cemetery.
[*]Added more interactions.
[*]Dead characters added.[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34292813/2c65ed470e83ecc1da132465ef456ea585a97a22.png[/img]
